title: NSW digital signs in transport corridors
source_title: Transport Corridor Outdoor Advertising and Signage Guidelines (NSW Department of Planning and Environment, November 2017)
status_note: Every value checked against the source PDF on 22 October 2026 (page citations below); not yet independently reviewed
notes: Page numbers are the guidelines' printed page numbers; add 2 for the PDF page.

The source URL refuses automated downloads. The copy checked was the web.archive.org capture of it, whose text is identical to https://www.planning.nsw.gov.au/sites/default/files/2023-03/transport-corridor-outdoor-advertising-and-signage-guidelines.pdf.

Luminance zones follow Table 6: zone_1 (very high ambient light, e.g. CBDs), zone_2 and zone_3 (high and medium), zone_4 (low, e.g. rural or near homes). Full sun on the face of the sign has no limit in any zone, and zone_1 has no daytime limit.
school_zone applies to a sign within 250 m of a classified road and visible from a school zone; set placement.school_zone for such signs.
Not encoded: sign spacing (Table 3 (l)), clearances and road safety checks (Table 3 (m)-(o)), which are siting conditions rather than creative or playback rules.
